name: Russo-Turkish War and the Annexation of Bessarabia (1806–1812) (C0039)

techniques.comment: The severing of Bessarabia from the Ottoman Empire and its official annexation under the Peace of Bucharest: the treaty "confirmed the annexation of Bessarabia to Russia and the transfer of the border from the Dniester to the Prut down to its confluence with the Danube"(Citation: Енциклопедія історії України: Т. 9 2012).

The use of Ukrainian Cossack formations in the imperial war: "The Russian troops, which included the Ust-Danube Budjak Cossack Host, captured Khotyn, Bendery… Akkerman"(Citation: Енциклопедія історії України: Т. 9 2012).
